reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

thesis: The transcript details Anne Martin's career path from competitive rowing and consulting to investment banking, private equity, and finally endowment management at Yale and Wesleyan University. It highlights the specific skills and mindset shifts required when transitioning from a transactional investment banking role to the more thoughtful practice of investment management.
